name: Cactus Compute
one_liner: YC S25 cross-platform inference engine and SDKs for running LLMs on phones and wearables.
local_ai_angle: C++ engine with Flutter/React Native/Kotlin/Swift SDKs; on-device by default, optional cloud fallback.

name: RunAnywhere
one_liner: YC W26 open-source SDK plus control plane to run multimodal AI on-device at scale.
local_ai_angle: One SDK for on-device LLM/speech/vision on iOS, Android, React Native; OTA model rollouts, hybrid routing.

name: Nexa AI
one_liner: Nexa SDK runs text, vision, audio and image models locally on NPU, GPU or CPU.
local_ai_angle: NPU-first on-device runtime (NexaML) for phones, PCs, IoT; continues as Qualcomm GenieX after acquisition.

name: Mirai
one_liner: Rust inference engine and SDK optimizing on-device model inference, starting with Apple Silicon.
local_ai_angle: Runtime (uzu) embedded in apps; claims faster generation than MLX; Android support planned.

name: Liquid AI (LEAP)
one_liner: MIT spinout building efficient LFM2 foundation models and the LEAP edge AI developer platform.
local_ai_angle: LEAP SDK deploys small LFM models on iOS/Android/laptops (AMD Ryzen AI); Apollo offline app.

name: ZETIC.ai
one_liner: MLange (ex-Melange) platform converting models into device-specific NPU libraries for mobile apps.
local_ai_angle: Moves B2B AI services from GPU servers onto phone NPUs; claims up to 60x vs mobile CPU.

name: ggml.ai (llama.cpp)
one_liner: Company behind ggml tensor library, llama.cpp and whisper.cpp, the de facto local inference stack.
local_ai_angle: Runs quantized GGUF LLMs and speech models on laptops, phones, edge; team joined Hugging Face.

name: MLC (MLC-LLM / WebLLM)
one_liner: Open-source ML compilation project deploying LLMs natively on phones, GPUs and in browsers.
local_ai_angle: WebLLM runs LLMs in-browser via WebGPU/WASM; MLC-LLM compiles models for iOS/Android/desktop.

name: Mozilla.ai (llamafile)
one_liner: Mozilla's AI arm; llamafile packages an LLM and runtime into one cross-platform executable.
local_ai_angle: Single-file local LLM execution on any desktop OS/CPU without install or cloud.

name: Exo Labs
one_liner: Open-source exo software linking everyday devices into a peer-to-peer local AI cluster.
local_ai_angle: Shards large models across Macs/phones/PCs at home to run frontier-size models locally.

name: Nomic AI (GPT4All)
one_liner: Builds GPT4All desktop app/SDK and Nomic embedding models plus Atlas data platform.
local_ai_angle: GPT4All runs open LLMs privately on consumer CPUs/GPUs with local document chat.

name: Fluid Inference (FluidAudio)
one_liner: Maintains FluidAudio, open-source Swift SDK for local ASR, TTS, diarization and VAD.
local_ai_angle: Offloads audio models to Apple Neural Engine on macOS/iOS; used by Spokenly, Hedy and others.

name: Aizip
one_liner: Silicon Valley maker of tiny edge models, incl. Gizmo small language models (300M-2B).
local_ai_angle: Models for MCUs, smart sensors, wearables; demoed SLM agents on Renesas Arm MPUs.

name: Tether (QVAC)
one_liner: Stablecoin issuer's QVAC open-source SDK for building local, offline AI apps.
local_ai_angle: QVAC Fabric (llama.cpp fork) plus whisper.cpp/Parakeet/Bergamot across phones, desktops, servers.

name: NobodyWho
one_liner: Open-source llama.cpp-based engine for running LLMs inside games and apps on-device.
local_ai_angle: Local LLM plugins across six platforms/frameworks incl. iOS/Android demos; no cloud calls.

name: Second State (LlamaEdge / WasmEdge)
one_liner: Maintainer of WasmEdge runtime and LlamaEdge for portable LLM apps via WebAssembly.
local_ai_angle: Runs LLM inference portably on edge devices and laptops through a lightweight Wasm runtime.

name: Tracel AI (Burn)
one_liner: Develops Burn, a Rust deep-learning framework with WebGPU, Metal, CUDA and embedded backends.
local_ai_angle: Portable training/inference from browsers (WASM/WebGPU) to no_std embedded devices.

name: Software Mansion (React Native ExecuTorch)
one_liner: Software house building React Native ExecuTorch and on-device AI app development services.
local_ai_angle: Open-source bindings to run ExecuTorch models locally in React Native mobile apps.

name: Datasapiens
one_liner: Low-code mobile SDK for building on-device AI features into apps.
local_ai_angle: Packages model execution on the handset so features run without cloud inference.

name: Cephable
one_liner: Enterprise startup building AI agents that run directly on laptops and devices.
local_ai_angle: On-device agents keep enterprise data off the cloud; raised $7M seed (Nov 2026).

name: TraceWeave
one_liner: Korean startup building an architecture for running AI agents on-device.
local_ai_angle: On-device agent runtime; $2.3M seed led by Mirae Asset Capital with Naver D2SF (Oct 2026).

name: Out of Set
one_liner: Korean on-device AI infrastructure startup focused initially on speech recognition and synthesis.
local_ai_angle: Builds on-device speech models for smartphones and devices; seed led by TheVentures (2026).

name: Iconic
one_liner: Gaming startup whose ACT-1 on-device engine lets players control characters by voice.
local_ai_angle: Interprets spoken input and drives game characters locally on the player's device; GBP10M seed.

name: Picovoice
one_liner: On-device voice AI platform: wake word, VAD, STT, speaker recognition, TTS and picoLLM.
local_ai_angle: Engines process audio fully on-device across mobile, web (WASM), desktop, MCUs; picoLLM local LLMs.

name: Argmax
one_liner: Builds WhisperKit, SpeakerKit, TTSKit and Pro SDK for on-device speech AI.
local_ai_angle: Optimized speech foundation models on Apple Silicon and Android (LiteRT); $8M seed 2024.

name: Moonshine AI
one_liner: Pete Warden's company (ex-Useful Sensors) commercializing Moonshine on-device speech recognition models.
local_ai_angle: Small open ASR models for local voice commands/transcription on edge hardware; Wing VC, IQT funding.

name: Sensory
one_liner: Veteran embedded voice/vision AI vendor (TrulyHandsfree) for automotive, consumer and IoT.
local_ai_angle: 100% on-device wake word, STT, voice commands with LLM handoff for complex queries.

name: Speechmatics
one_liner: Speech recognition company offering cloud, on-prem and on-device speech-to-text.
local_ai_angle: Speechmatics On-Device runs ASR on end-user hardware with no audio leaving device.

name: Cartesia
one_liner: Voice AI company built on state-space models; Sonic TTS plus on-device offerings.
local_ai_angle: Open-source Edge library for SSMs on Apple silicon; Sonic On-Device for phones.

name: Kyutai
one_liner: Paris non-profit open AI lab focused on voice models (Moshi, Pocket TTS).
local_ai_angle: Releases open models like 100M-param Pocket TTS that run real-time on CPUs locally.

name: Gradium
one_liner: Kyutai spinout building low-latency audio language models for voice AI.
local_ai_angle: Released Phonon, open-weight on-device TTS (31M/40M params); mostly cloud otherwise.

name: Neuphonic
one_liner: Voice AI startup releasing NeuTTS open on-device speech language models with voice cloning.
local_ai_angle: NeuTTS models run text-to-speech locally on devices under open licenses.

name: KittenML (Kitten TTS)
one_liner: Developer of Kitten TTS, tiny 15M-80M parameter open text-to-speech models.
local_ai_angle: 25-80MB TTS models run on CPUs and edge devices without GPU.

name: SoundHound AI
one_liner: Public voice AI company (Houndify) for automotive, restaurants and devices.
local_ai_angle: Edge/on-chip voice AI with on-device LLM on NVIDIA DRIVE; works without connectivity.

name: Cerence
one_liner: Automotive voice and conversational AI supplier (ex-Nuance) to major carmakers.
local_ai_angle: CaLLM Edge 3.8B embedded SLM runs in head units offline or as hybrid backup.

name: Kardome
one_liner: Spatial hearing voice AI that isolates speakers by seat for cars and devices.
local_ai_angle: Deploys proprietary voice models on edge hardware (NVIDIA AGX); partners with SoundHound.

name: Alpha Cephei (Vosk)
one_liner: Maker of Vosk, open-source offline speech recognition toolkit for 20+ languages.
local_ai_angle: Small ASR models run offline on Android, iOS, Raspberry Pi and servers.

name: k2-fsa (sherpa-onnx / Next-gen Kaldi)
one_liner: Open-source Next-gen Kaldi project; sherpa-onnx offers offline ASR, TTS, VAD, diarization.
local_ai_angle: ONNX-based speech runtime for Android, iOS, Raspberry Pi, embedded boards and WebAssembly.

name: Coqui
one_liner: Open-source speech startup behind Coqui TTS and XTTS voice cloning models.
local_ai_angle: Open TTS models widely self-hosted and run locally; company shut down early 2024.

name: Moondream (M87 Labs)
one_liner: Tiny open vision-language models (Moondream 0.5B/2B/3) for image understanding.
local_ai_angle: Compact VLMs run on edge devices and phones; $4.5M pre-seed (Felicis, M12).

name: Nota AI
one_liner: AI model optimization company; NetsPresso platform compresses models for edge hardware.
local_ai_angle: Optimizes and deploys models on-device (Qualcomm AI Hub, NVIDIA, Samsung); KOSDAQ-listed Nov 2025.

name: ENERZAi
one_liner: Full-stack on-device AI company doing model compression and compiler-level optimization.
local_ai_angle: Optimizes models (Optimium engine) to run on edge devices incl. in-car systems.

name: Plumerai
one_liner: Tiny on-device vision AI (people/face detection) for smart home cameras and chips.
local_ai_angle: Runs compact detection models on camera MCUs/SoCs without cloud processing.

name: Xnor.ai
one_liner: AI2 spinout pioneering binarized on-device vision models for low-power devices.
local_ai_angle: Ran deep learning on battery-powered edge devices; bought by Apple.

name: Hugging Face
one_liner: Open model hub; ships Transformers.js, swift-transformers, SmolLM and now hosts ggml/llama.cpp.
local_ai_angle: Transformers.js runs models in-browser (ONNX/WebGPU); acquired ggml.ai team for local AI.

name: Google (AI Edge: LiteRT, MediaPipe, Gemini Nano)
one_liner: Google's on-device AI stack: LiteRT, MediaPipe LLM Inference, Gemini Nano/AICore, Chrome built-in AI.
local_ai_angle: Firebase AI Logic hybrid inference routes between on-device Gemini Nano and cloud.

name: Apple (Core ML, MLX, Foundation Models)
one_liner: Apple's on-device ML frameworks: Core ML, MLX, Foundation Models framework, SpeechAnalyzer.
local_ai_angle: Apple Intelligence runs on-device first, escalating to Private Cloud Compute (hybrid).

name: Meta (ExecuTorch)
one_liner: PyTorch's on-device inference runtime for mobile, embedded and wearable devices.
local_ai_angle: Deploys PyTorch/Llama models on phones, AR/VR and MCUs; powers Meta apps.

name: Microsoft (Foundry Local, Windows ML, ONNX Runtime)
one_liner: Microsoft's local inference stack: Foundry Local, Windows ML, ONNX Runtime, Phi small models.
local_ai_angle: Runs models on Windows/Mac PCs across CPU/GPU/NPU; ONNX Runtime Web for browsers.

name: Qualcomm (AI Hub, GenieX)
one_liner: Snapdragon chipmaker offering AI Hub model zoo, AI Engine Direct and GenieX SDK.
local_ai_angle: Optimizes/deploys models to Hexagon NPU on phones, PCs, cars; acquired Nexa AI, Edge Impulse.

name: Intel (OpenVINO)
one_liner: Intel's OpenVINO toolkit and AI PC software for CPU, GPU and NPU inference.
local_ai_angle: Optimizes LLM/vision inference on Intel Core Ultra AI PCs and edge devices.

name: AMD (Ryzen AI, Lemonade)
one_liner: AMD Ryzen AI PC software incl. Lemonade local LLM server; investor in Liquid AI.
local_ai_angle: Local LLM serving on Ryzen AI NPU/iGPU; LEAP models accelerated on Ryzen.

name: NVIDIA (RTX AI PC, DRIVE, Jetson)
one_liner: GPU leader providing RTX AI PC, Jetson and DRIVE platforms for local inference.
local_ai_angle: Hosts on-device LLMs in cars (SoundHound, Cerence) and RTX PCs; acquired OctoAI, Deci.

name: Arm (KleidiAI)
one_liner: CPU IP licensor; KleidiAI libraries accelerate on-device AI on Arm CPUs.
local_ai_angle: Kleidi speeds LLMs like Cerence CaLLM Edge on Arm phone/car chipsets.

name: MediaTek (NeuroPilot)
one_liner: Mobile and automotive SoC maker with NeuroPilot on-device AI SDK.
local_ai_angle: Runs multimodal LLMs on Dimensity phones and auto chips (with Cerence, NVIDIA).

name: Alibaba (MNN)
one_liner: Alibaba's MNN lightweight inference engine, incl. MNN-LLM for phones.
local_ai_angle: Runs LLMs and diffusion models on Android/iOS devices; open source.

name: Tencent (ncnn)
one_liner: Tencent's ncnn high-performance neural network inference framework optimized for mobile.
local_ai_angle: Widely embedded on-device vision inference for Android/iOS with Vulkan GPU support.

name: ThunderSoft (Rubik Device AI)
one_liner: Chinese OS/edge software vendor with Rubik on-device LLM for phones, cars, IoT.
local_ai_angle: Supplies on-device AI OS stacks to OEMs on Qualcomm/other SoCs.

name: PrismML
one_liner: AI lab building small reasoning LLMs that run on PCs and smartphones.
local_ai_angle: Shrinks reasoning models for on-device use; $22.25M seed from Khosla, Cerberus, Caltech.

name: Edge Impulse
one_liner: Edge ML development platform for building and deploying models to MCUs and devices.
local_ai_angle: TinyML/edge model training and deployment to embedded hardware; now part of Qualcomm.

name: Imagimob
one_liner: TinyML studio for building edge AI models for sensors and MCUs.
local_ai_angle: Deploys audio/sensor models on microcontrollers; integrated into Infineon ModusToolbox.

name: OctoAI (OctoML)
one_liner: Apache TVM creators' model optimization and inference company.
local_ai_angle: Compiler tech (TVM/MLC roots) for efficient inference across hardware; bought by NVIDIA.

name: Deci
one_liner: Neural architecture search and efficient model company (YOLO-NAS, DeciLM).
local_ai_angle: Produced hardware-aware efficient models for edge and on-prem; bought by NVIDIA.

name: Neural Magic
one_liner: Sparsification/quantization company and major vLLM contributor.
local_ai_angle: Ran sparse models efficiently on CPUs and self-hosted GPUs; bought by Red Hat.

name: Embedl
one_liner: Model optimization SDK making deep learning models efficient for embedded hardware.
local_ai_angle: Compresses models for automotive and edge devices; hardware-aware optimization.

name: SqueezeBits
one_liner: Korean AI model compression and quantization startup.
local_ai_angle: Quantizes LLMs/vision models for on-device and efficient inference.

name: Clika
one_liner: Automated AI model compression engine for edge deployment.
local_ai_angle: Compresses models to fit edge hardware targets.

name: Pruna AI
one_liner: Open-source model optimization framework combining quantization, pruning, caching, compilation.
local_ai_angle: Makes models smaller/faster for self-hosted and edge deployment.

name: Multiverse Computing
one_liner: Quantum-inspired AI compression (CompactifAI) producing tiny LLMs.
local_ai_angle: Compressed models for on-prem and on-device deployment.

name: Roboflow
one_liner: Computer vision platform with open-source Inference server for edge deployment.
local_ai_angle: Self-hosted/edge vision inference on Jetson, CPUs, cameras.

name: Latent AI
one_liner: Edge AI optimization platform (LEIP) for defense and industrial devices.
local_ai_angle: Compiles and secures models for disconnected edge hardware.

name: DeGirum
one_liner: Edge AI software (PySDK) spanning many accelerators plus AI hardware.
local_ai_angle: Hardware-agnostic edge inference SDK for Hailo, Intel, NVIDIA, etc.

name: Syntiant
one_liner: Ultra-low-power neural decision processors and edge models for voice/sensors.
local_ai_angle: Always-on on-device wake word and sensor AI in earbuds, wearables.

name: Quadric
one_liner: Licensable inference engine processor IP (Chimera GPNPU) for on-device AI chips.
local_ai_angle: NPU IP runs LLMs/vision on edge SoCs; $30M Series C.

name: Axelera AI
one_liner: Edge AI accelerator chips (Metis) and Voyager SDK.
local_ai_angle: Low-power inference hardware for edge devices and PCs.

name: Edgerunner AI
one_liner: On-device, air-gapped AI agents for military and enterprise users.
local_ai_angle: Runs LLM agents locally on laptops/devices without connectivity.

name: webAI
one_liner: Local AI platform (Navigator) for building and running models across owned devices.
local_ai_angle: Distributed private inference on customer hardware instead of cloud.

name: GaiaNet
one_liner: Decentralized network of self-hosted AI agent nodes.
local_ai_angle: Nodes run open LLMs on personal hardware; raised $10M.

name: Open Home Foundation (Piper, Home Assistant voice)
one_liner: Non-profit owning Home Assistant and local voice projects like Piper TTS.
local_ai_angle: Fully local smart-home voice assistant pipeline on user hardware.

name: Ollama
one_liner: Popular tool to download and run open LLMs locally with an API.
local_ai_angle: Local LLM runtime/server on Mac, Windows, Linux built on llama.cpp heritage.

name: LM Studio (Element Labs)
one_liner: Desktop app and SDK for discovering and running local LLMs.
local_ai_angle: Runs GGUF/MLX models locally with OpenAI-compatible local server.

name: Jan (Menlo Research)
one_liner: Open-source offline ChatGPT alternative desktop app.
local_ai_angle: Runs LLMs 100% locally via llama.cpp engine.

name: Locally AI
one_liner: iOS/Mac app for chatting with open models (e.g., Qwen) fully offline.
local_ai_angle: Runs LLMs on-device on Apple hardware with no cloud.
